observations: A solid black silhouette of a figure in a pointed hat leans over a round cauldron at left; the cauldron carries hand-lettered text 'SCAFFOLD ETH' in white.
The background is a flat, saturated yellow-green; short wavy lines radiate outward from the cauldron area and fill the right half of the field, drawn in the same dark ink as the figure.
The figure's lower body rests on a ladder-like structure whose rungs cast a dense hatched shadow across the ground plane, anchoring the composition at the bottom edge.
reading: A silhouetted figure bends over a labeled cauldron, its pointed hat and splayed hair evoking stock symbols of brewing or conjuring. The wavy lines spreading across the yellow-green field read less as steam than as visual noise—agitation without a clear source. The hand-lettered text on the cauldron pulls the image between emblem and joke, holding ceremony and deflation at once.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work's flat two-tone field and embedded text contrast sharply with the layered rendering and dark ground of title neighbor nnxyz nnotb #95. Title order and recorded creation order align for these two works.

connections.reason: nnxyz nnotb #95 uses dense overlapping marks and a dark ground, making it a direct tonal contrast to this work's open yellow-green field and clean silhouette.

lookingQuestion: Where do the wavy lines begin and end relative to the cauldron, and does their density change as they move toward the edges of the image?
ambiguities: The text 'SCAFFOLD ETH' is treated as image content; its referential meaning outside the image is not addressed.
nnxyz nnotb #97 and nnxyz nifty faces #31 share no strong formal connection to this work beyond the same artist signature; neither is selected as a comparison.
